skip_reason: Not a sales call. This is a post-move damage/claims and billing-resolution call on a completed move. The customer walks through crew performance complaints (items wrapped in stretch plastic instead of moving blankets, Sleep Number handling, dryer vent coil damage, marble/travertine chip, desk legs, wall damage), Frank pulls up the existing damage record (six items), reviews dispatch notes and crew timing, discusses the customer's open claim with Stephanie in customer service, and offers a roughly $814 refund to match the original nine-hour quote against the 13.5 hours billed. No quote, no pricing pitch, no booking. Handled well as a service-recovery call, but there is nothing on the sales scorecard to grade.
top_strength: Not graded against the sales scorecard.
